rows.title: The city of Suslanger and its environs

versions.guide:
Find the meeting place

The meeting place is a short distance to the south east from the cave exit. You should have a good look around to ensure the meeting will be safe.

Make sure the meeting is safe

There is a guards' unit near the meeting place. You do not know whether the guards suspect that something is afoot, or if it is just a routine check, but kill them anyway.
versions.html:
Antiques collector

The meeting is arranged in a secluded place used by city merchants and inhabitants of the Last Shelter for their secret trade. But it may be wise to take a good look around, if only to be safe from ambush.
